name: comic_studio_claude
description: Multi-agent comic illustration studio with specialized artistic roles

subagents.name: penciler
subagents.description: Establishes composition, layout, anatomical proportions, and solid vector boundary paths.

subagents.name: colorist
subagents.description: Applies 4-tier color palettes, 5 anatomical cel-shadow planes, SkSL dot halftone shaders, and rim lights.

subagents.name: inker
subagents.description: Renders crisp calligraphic ink contours, tapered hair strokes, feathering, cross-hatching, and solid blacks.

subagents.name: critic
subagents.description: Performs side-by-side gap analysis vs reference image, executes refinement passes, and produces final artwork.
